status_note: Not tested by us. Everything here is copied from the vendor's pages on the dates given; run `python -m rak.models control kimi` before relying on it.

claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: kimi-k2.7-code forces thinking on; with thinking off requests fail with "400 invalid thinking: only type=enabled is allowed for this model"
"Configuring only some of the variables makes the corresponding scenarios fail silently": every model variable must be set
the guide's curl check uses kimi-k3.1-pro while its configuration uses kimi-k3[1m]; the difference is not explained
the vendor also sets CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000 and CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max; not applied by this profile
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes

data_policy.training: by default; opt-out only via "enterprise arrangements"
